item.title: REF 0.5.0
item.description:
• New: the REF plug-in, which replaces REF Send. Put REF last on your master bus and drop a reference on it. Every pass you play is measured in REF's own window when you stop. The reference stays saved with your project.
  • In the plug-in, A / B (or R, and M to go back) plays the reference in place of your mix through your DAW. It plays from its loudest part, turned to your mix's loudness, and your mix's level is never touched. A bounce always gets your mix.
  • In the plug-in, live meters show your mix's loudness, peaks, spectrum and stereo as your DAW plays it.
  • Waveforms now use Traktor-style colours by default, with the sub picked out in darker colours.
  • Every band name now shows its range in Hz, for example "Muddy low mids (250–500 Hz)".
  • Fixed: the "Heaviest at" play buttons sat on top of a note's title until the window was resized.
